'''Isobe Shrine''' ({{lang|ja|石部神社}}, Isobe Jinja) is a [[Shinto shrine]] located in {{ill|Komatsu|ja|小松市|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Komatsu|qq=}}, {{ill|Ishikawa Prefecture|ja|石川県|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ishikawa Prefecture|qq=}}, Japan. It served as the General Shrine ({{ill|Sōja|ja|総社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sōja|qq=}}) of {{ill|Kaga Province|ja|加賀国|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaga Province|qq=}}. The shrine is listed in the {{ill|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki|qq=}} register of shrines and previously held the status of {{ill|Gōsha|ja|郷社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gōsha|qq=}} under the modern shrine Ranking system.

== deity ==
The enshrined deity is Kushihikatawakeno Mikoto. However, records such as the *Kaga Province Shikinaisha Kyuuki* refer to the deity as {{ill|Ōmononushi|ja|大物主|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōmononushi|qq=}}, and during the early modern period, the shrine was known as "Funamiyamaō Myōjin."

== History ==
The founding date of Isobe Shrine is unknown. It is believed to have existed prior to the separation of Kaga Province from {{ill|Echizen Province|ja|越前国|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Echizen Province|qq=}} in {{nihongo|823|弘仁14}}. Due to its location south of the provincial capital ({{nihongo|Kokufu|国府}}), the shrine was also referred to as "Funan-sha" (府南社). However, *Shirayama no Ki* suggests that Funan-sha was established when Kaga Province was formed.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ishikawa-jinjacho.or.jp/shrine/j0664/|title=Isobe Shrine|accessdate=2020-09-25|publisher=Ishikawa Prefecture Shrine Agency}}</ref> 

The shrine is listed in the *Engishiki Jinmyōchō* as "Kaga Province, Nomigun, Isobe Shrine" (加賀国能美郡 石部神社), categorized as a minor shrine.

Isobe Shrine likely served as the General Shrine of Kaga Province and enjoyed significant influence for a time. However, its power waned following the {{nihongo|Yūsenji Incident|涌泉寺事件}} in {{nihongo|1176|安元2}}. In {{nihongo|1600|慶長5}}, {{ill|Niwa Nagashige|ja|丹羽長重|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Niwa Nagashige|qq=}} undertook renovations of the shrine buildings, and during the {{nihongo|Edo period|江戸時代}}, the shrine received protection from the {{ill|Kaga Domain|ja|加賀藩|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaga Domain|qq=}} lords. There was a period when the shrine was considered the Ichinomiya of Kaga Province, leading to disputes with {{ill|Shirayama Hime Shrine|ja|白山比咩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shirayama Hime Shrine|qq=}}.
